title: An algebraic multiscale preconditioner for large sparse SPD matrices
summary: We present a two-grid algebraic multiscale preconditioner for large sparse symmetric positive definite systems arising from elliptic problems with highly heterogeneous coefficients. The coarse space is constructed directly from the system matrix by graph partitioning and local generalized eigenvalue solvers, yielding basis functions that capture the low-energy modes responsible for slow convergence.
